description: This file defines a utility class 'History' for managing a bounded list of recent items (history entries) persisted in Android SharedPreferences. It provides methods to load, add, and retrieve history items, maintaining a maximum size.

classes.name: History
classes.description: A utility class to maintain a history list stored in SharedPreferences with functionalities to load, add, and keep the history within a specified size limit.

methods.name: History
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the History object with SharedPreferences, a key, and maximum size.

methods.name: ensureMaxSize
methods.description: Ensures the internal list does not exceed the maximum size by removing oldest entries.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the history items from SharedPreferences into the list.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current list of items into SharedPreferences.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new item to the history list, trimming whitespace and avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: addAllTo
methods.description: Adds all items from history to a given collection, most recent items first.
